semiconductor_relevance: High — Bruco Integrated Circuits specializes in designing and supplying custom ASICs, which are integral to semiconductor applications.
summary: Bruco Integrated Circuits is a fabless ASIC design center that provides end-to-end solutions from system specification to silicon delivery. They focus on RF, analog/mixed signal custom ICs for various applications requiring secure communications and precise control.

regional_presence.Netherlands: The company is headquartered in Borne, Netherlands, with design offices in Nijmegen.
regional_presence.Germany: Bruco has additional design offices in Berlin, Germany.
